title: CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #6 OPERATION WILD SCALES OPEN
lines: 01 CONTINGENCY CONTRACT: SEASON #6 OPERATION WILD SCALES OPEN
DURATION: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 15, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-10
SEASON DETAILS: During the season, players can combine different "Contracts" to clear stages, complete challenges, improve level evaluation, and collect "Contract Bounty" and "Operation Agreement."
- "Contract Bounty" can be used to redeem rewards in "Secret Sanctuary."
- "Operation Agreement" can be used to unlock more Contingency Contract contents.
CROSS-SEASON " SECRET SANCTUARY" OPEN
- Cross-Season Permanent Trade Center New Arrivals:
Coral Coast Collection - Casual Vacation HD31 for Warfarin
Witch Feast Series - Imp's House for Rope (Re-edition)
Season #6 Furniture - Wild Scales Pennant
- Season #6 Special Trade Center Supplies: Elite Materials, LMD, Furniture Parts, Battle Records, Chips, etc.
DURATION: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 15, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
NOTE:
- You do not need Sanity to play Contingency Contract stages.
- You need a certain number of completed Contracts to unlock some other Contracts. Please note that the number of completed Contracts DOES NOT EQUAL to Contingency Level.

- Compared with Season #5, Season #6 still has 8 sites in total, but has replaced 2 sites from the previous Season. There will be a new Rotating Site and a new Permanent Site, and the Permanent Site from last Season will be added into Rotating Sites. During the season, there will be 1 Permanent Site and 7 Rotating Sites (rotating daily) for you to challenge. (The first Rotating Site's rotation time and its corresponding challenges on the first day of the event will be extended by 1 day.)
- Several new Contracts and challenges will be added to the Season's Permanent Site on March 8, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- After Season #6 ends, the unused Contract Bounty will be retained.
- After Season #6 ends, all the Operation Agreements you have collected this season will be automatically converted into Operation Wild Scales Supplies, the ratio is 1:1.
- During Season #6, you will receive Credits if your Support Units have helped others in clearing their Contingency Contract stages.
- During Season #6, players can obtain Season #6 Engraved Medal Set by achieving related goals.
02 SUPPLIES EVERYDAY ACCESS
DURATION: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 15, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: All stages in Supplies stay open during the period above.
03 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN: UNBOUND REFLUX
DURATION: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 15, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Headhunting, "Unbound Reflux", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Thorns (50% in 6* Operators)
★★★★★: Andreana / Provence (50% in 5* Operators)
★★★★: Jaye (20% in 4* Operators)
NOTE:
"Unbound Reflux" belongs to "Standard Headhunting."

DURATION: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 15, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Re-edition Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Silent Night DN02 for Shining
Coral Coast Collection - Temperature Difference RT.RX01 for Skyfire
Coral Coast Collection - Casual Vacation HD01 for Vigna
Coral Coast Collection - Sunburn SS.SP for Ifrit
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA361 for Sora
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA011 for Gummy
05 RE-EDITION FURNITURE SET – RHODES ISLAND WORKSTATION
DURATION: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - March 15, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: This furniture set will be available again during the event.
06 NEW PERMANENT FURNITURE SET AVAILABLE AT STORE
UPDATE TIME: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following furniture will be permanently available in the Store for purchase after March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7), including:
Themed Furniture Set - Rhodes Island Modern Music Rehearsal Room
Themed Furniture Set - Siesta Beach Hut
'Extreme' Mixing Table
'Professional' Speaker System
'Stylish' Portable Stereo
07 NEW FUNCTION UPDATED: RECORD RESTORATION
UPDATE TIME: March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: New function Record Restoration will be available on March 1, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7). The limited event rewards from past events will be permanently available for players to unlock.
The Record Restoration of Heart of Surging Flame will be open after the next update. Please pay attention to our official Twitter / Facebook for more details about the new function.
08 NEW ANNIHILATION – LONG SPRING WASTES
UPDATE TIME: March 7, 2022, 04:00 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 2-8
DETAILS: Watery Tidehollow will be replaced by New Annihilation Mission Long Spring Wastes. Watery Tidehollow will be added to the list of Hypothetical Annihilation Targets after it ends.
